items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: Because Freddy and him were real tight... That's why I said that wasn't Freddy... Freddy was the big attraction.

ctx.x: And then you said Duke Ellington lived above or below.
Below. Well, he was always in the apartment. It was just like his apartment. Because Freddy and him were real tight, you know. Duke was always up there.
Well, tell me the story about when you walked in and Duke asked you... You walked in like three in the morning.
